maintainer.contact: Repository issue / PR tagged app:cadence (environment PR #15, @ZichenYuan)

capabilities.ui: business web app (pale.web) plus reviewer renderer

limitations: One member account per instance; no social features, instructor marketplace or real payments.
Notices to Mail are built and published by the host-run publisher after a commit; the App never observes delivery outcomes and records no notice status.
Cadence is the source of truth for its own reservations only; overlaps with other commitments are the agent's check through Calendar's tools.
Nothing fires when the clock moves: waitlist promotions, renewals, reminders and studio changes are events the task applies through Infra.
